bg.9.18.m: I am the goal, the sustainer, the master, the witness, the home, the refuge and the friend; the origin and the dissolution, the ground, the treasure-house and the undying seed.
roles: Gives home and shelter in him.
bg.9.18.sa: गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् । प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥

bg.9.22.m: To those who think of me alone and worship me, ever devoted, I bring what they lack and preserve what they have.
roles: Shows provision and protection are promised.
bg.9.22.sa: अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते । तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥

bg.9.26.m: Whoever offers me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit or water, that offering of love from the pure-hearted I accept.
roles: Shows offering even a little as thanks.
bg.9.26.sa: पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति । तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥

bg.9.27.m: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer, whatever you give, whatever austerity you practise, Kaunteya, do it as an offering to me.
roles: Shows each meal and gift handed back.
bg.9.27.sa: यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत् । यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ॥

bg.9.29.m: I am the same to all beings; none is hateful to me and none dear. But those who worship me with devotion are in me, and I am in them.
bg.9.29.sa: समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः । ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥

bg.9.30.m: Even if one of very bad conduct worships me with undivided devotion, he should be regarded as good, for he has resolved rightly.
roles: Names right resolve as what is honoured.
bg.9.30.sa: अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक् । साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ॥

bg.9.31.m: He soon becomes righteous and attains lasting peace. Kaunteya, declare it boldly: my devotee never perishes.
bg.9.31.sa: क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति । कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥

bg.9.34.m: Fix your mind on me, be devoted to me, sacrifice to me, bow to me. Having joined yourself to me, with me as your goal, you will come to me.
roles: Shows mind, love, worship and bowing turned to him.
bg.9.34.sa: मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु । मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः ॥

bg.9.6.m: As the mighty wind, moving everywhere, always rests in space, know that all beings rest in me.
roles: Shows the sky not disturbed by the wind in it.
bg.9.6.sa: यथाऽऽकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् । तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय ॥

st.bg.arjuna_apology_to_friend.l: We take those closest to us for granted; it is never too late to say sorry.
st.bg.arjuna_apology_to_friend.s: Trembling, Arjuna praises Krishna, asks pardon for having treated him as just a friend, begs him to bear with him as a father, friend or lover would, and asks to see his familiar form.
st.bg.arjuna_apology_to_friend.t: Terrified, Arjuna prays to see the gentle four-armed form

st.bg.arjuna_collapse_between_armies.l: Even the strongest people freeze; the Gita begins with a breakdown, not a hero.
st.bg.arjuna_collapse_between_armies.s: Seeing his kin ready to die, Arjuna trembles, his bow slips, and he argues that no victory is worth killing family. He sits down in the chariot and refuses to fight.
st.bg.arjuna_collapse_between_armies.t: Overcome by delusion, Arjuna speaks in fear, love and grief

st.bg.arjuna_i_am_your_student.l: Admitting you don't know and asking for help is where clarity begins.
st.bg.arjuna_i_am_your_student.s: Krishna challenges Arjuna's despair. Arjuna admits he is confused about what is right, cannot tell which choice is better, and asks Krishna to teach him.
st.bg.arjuna_i_am_your_student.t: Krishna and Arjuna on Arjuna's faint-heartedness

st.bg.arjuna_i_will_not_fight.l: Admitting you don't know and asking for help is where clarity begins.
st.bg.arjuna_i_will_not_fight.s: Krishna challenges Arjuna's despair. Arjuna admits he is confused about what is right, cannot tell which choice is better, and asks Krishna to teach him.
st.bg.arjuna_i_will_not_fight.t: Krishna and Arjuna on Arjuna's faint-heartedness

st.bg.arjuna_mind_like_wind.l: The mind is hard to hold, but practice and letting go train it.
st.bg.arjuna_mind_like_wind.s: Arjuna says the mind is restless, stormy and stubborn. Krishna agrees, and says practice and letting go can train it.

st.bg.arjuna_mixed_messages.l: Not acting is still a choice; do the work that is yours.
st.bg.arjuna_mixed_messages.s: Arjuna is confused and asks for one clear answer. Krishna says no one can stop acting, that repressing the body while the mind indulges is self-deception, and that action beats inaction.
st.bg.arjuna_mixed_messages.t: Why doing your duty without attachment is better

st.bg.arjuna_sees_and_is_afraid.l: We take those closest to us for granted; it is never too late to say sorry.
st.bg.arjuna_sees_and_is_afraid.s: Trembling, Arjuna praises Krishna, asks pardon for having treated him as just a friend, begs him to bear with him as a father, friend or lover would, and asks to see his familiar form.
st.bg.arjuna_sees_and_is_afraid.t: Terrified, Arjuna prays to see the gentle four-armed form

st.bg.arjuna_what_drives_wrong.l: Desire unmet becomes anger; see it clearly and you can master it.
st.bg.arjuna_what_drives_wrong.s: Arjuna asks why we do wrong as if forced. Krishna names desire, which turns into anger, as the enemy that clouds wisdom like smoke over fire, and tells him to master it.

st.bg.arjuna_what_if_i_fail.l: No sincere effort is wasted; you pick up where you left off.
st.bg.arjuna_what_if_i_fail.s: Arjuna fears that one who falls short is lost like a torn cloud. Krishna promises that no one who does good comes to ruin; past effort carries forward and they strive again.
st.bg.arjuna_what_if_i_fail.t: What becomes of one who falls from yoga

st.bg.dhritarashtra_mine_and_pandus.l: Insecurity shows in how we size up rivals before anything has happened.
st.bg.dhritarashtra_mine_and_pandus.s: The blind king Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya what happened at Kurukshetra. Sanjaya describes Duryodhana going to Drona and nervously naming the great warriors on both sides.
st.bg.dhritarashtra_mine_and_pandus.t: The great warriors of both armies are named

st.bg.duryodhana_counts_the_enemy.l: Insecurity shows in how we size up rivals before anything has happened.
st.bg.duryodhana_counts_the_enemy.s: The blind king Dhritarashtra asks Sanjaya what happened at Kurukshetra. Sanjaya describes Duryodhana going to Drona and nervously naming the great warriors on both sides.
st.bg.duryodhana_counts_the_enemy.t: The great warriors of both armies are named

st.bg.i_am_time_be_the_instrument.l: Do your part without imagining everything rests on you.
st.bg.i_am_time_be_the_instrument.s: Krishna declares he is Time, the destroyer of worlds; the warriors will die even without Arjuna, so he should rise and be the instrument.
st.bg.i_am_time_be_the_instrument.t: "I am Time": Krishna urges Arjuna to fight

st.bg.if_you_cannot_then.l: If the ideal is too hard, take the next step down, and keep going.
st.bg.if_you_cannot_then.s: Krishna says devotion to a personal form is easier, then offers a ladder: fix your mind; if not, practise; if not, work for me; if not, let go of results. Letting go brings peace at once.
st.bg.if_you_cannot_then.t: Form or formless: which devotee is best, and the ways to reach him

st.bg.my_delusion_is_gone.l: Clarity, once found, turns into action.
st.bg.my_delusion_is_gone.s: Krishna asks if Arjuna's confusion is gone; Arjuna says yes and that he will act. Sanjaya rejoices and declares that where Krishna and Arjuna stand, victory follows.

st.bg.reflect_and_do_as_you_wish.l: Reflect fully, choose freely, and set down the fear.
st.bg.reflect_and_do_as_you_wish.s: Krishna urges Arjuna to offer all action, warns that ego will only trip him, tells him to reflect fully and then choose, and finally to take refuge in him alone and not grieve.

st.bg.sanjaya_remembering.l: Clarity, once found, turns into action.
st.bg.sanjaya_remembering.s: Krishna asks if Arjuna's confusion is gone; Arjuna says yes and that he will act. Sanjaya rejoices and declares that where Krishna and Arjuna stand, victory follows.
